question: Print the first 5 names of the passengers, sorted by name
reference_sql: SELECT passenger_name FROM passenger ORDER BY passenger_name LIMIT 5;

question: Print the names of all companies
Print all planes from flights from Washington
reference_sql: SELECT plane FROM trip WHERE town_from = 'Washington';

question: Print the names of people that end in "man"
reference_sql: SELECT passenger_name FROM passenger WHERE passenger_name LIKE '%man';

question: Print the number of flights made on Airbus A319
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE plane = 'Airbus A319';

question: Which companies have flown on Airbus A321-100
reference_sql: SELECT company_name FROM company Co LEFT JOIN trip Tr ON Tr.company_id = Co.company_id WHERE Tr.plane = 'Airbus A321-100';

question: Print all the names of the planes on which you can fly to California
reference_sql: SELECT plane FROM trip WHERE town_to = 'California';

question: Which companies organize flights from Gongkong?
reference_sql: SELECT company_name FROM company Co LEFT JOIN trip Tr ON Tr.company_id = Co.company_id WHERE Tr.town_from = 'Gongkong';

question: Print the ids and the count of passengers for all past trips
reference_sql: SELECT t.trip_id, COUNT(pt.passenger_id) FROM trip t LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip pt ON t.trip_id = pt.trip_id WHERE t.time_in < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY t.trip_id;

question: Which cities did Bob fly to
reference_sql: SELECT town_to FROM passenger Pa LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip PaTr ON Pa.passenger_id = PaTr.passenger_id LEFT JOIN trip Tr ON PaTr.trip_id = Tr.trip_id WHERE passenger_name = 'Bob';

question: Print the date and time of arrival of passenger John in California
reference_sql: SELECT time_in FROM trip Tr LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip PaTr ON PaTr.trip_Id = Tr.trip_id LEFT JOIN passenger Pa ON PaTr.passenger_id = Pa.passenger_id WHERE passenger_name = 'John' AND town_to = 'California';

question: How many flights have airlines flown from Washington to California?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE town_from = 'Washington' AND town_to = 'California';

question: Which cities can I fly to from Washington and how long will it take?
reference_sql: SELECT town_to, (time_in - time_out) FROM trip WHERE town_from = 'Washington';

question: Print the passengers with the longest name. Spaces, hyphens, and dots are considered part of the name
reference_sql: SELECT passenger_name FROM passenger WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(passenger_name) = (SELECT MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(passenger_name)) FROM passenger);

question: Print the names of the passengers who flew to California by Airbus A320 aircraft
reference_sql: SELECT passenger_name FROM passenger Pa LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip PaTr ON Pa.passenger_id = PaTr.passenger_id LEFT JOIN trip Tr ON PaTr.trip_id = Tr.trip_id WHERE town_to = 'California' AND plane = 'Airbus A320';
